allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Peter Klaven is a successful real estate agent who, upon getting engaged to the woman of his dreams, Zooey, discovers, to his dismay and chagrin, that he has no male friend close enough to serve as his Best Man. Peter immediately sets out to rectify the situation, embarking on a series of bizarre and awkward "man-dates."

facts.title: I Love You, Man

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Peter needs a best man fast, but can a series of painfully clumsy blind dates actually produce a genuine best friend before the wedding day?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After proposing to his dream woman Zooey, real estate agent Peter Klaven realizes he lacks any close male companions to be his best man, kicking off an immediate hunt through a string of awkward, mismatched man-dates.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and breezy, pairing steady comic momentum with low-stress viewing that is ideal to watch with friends.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director John Hamburg delivers an easygoing, laugh-out-loud comedy that turns modern male bonding and wedding anxiety into a genuinely funny, warm social obstacle course.
